cases.name: a copy's files are DELETE, the repo's own skill and script KEEP, a file added inside a kit skill MOVE, the repo's eval case ORPHAN
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/rc-{{SID}}
rm -rf $R
mkdir -p $R/.claude/hooks $R/.claude/scripts $R/.claude/skills/implement-tdd/references $R/.claude/skills/own-skill $R/.claude/evals/cases
cp {{KIT}}/hooks/bash-dispatch.sh $R/.claude/hooks/
cp {{KIT}}/scripts/pre-audit.sh $R/.claude/scripts/
printf x > $R/.claude/scripts/own.sh
printf 'read references/extra.md\n' > $R/.claude/skills/implement-tdd/SKILL.md
printf x > $R/.claude/skills/implement-tdd/references/extra.md
printf x > $R/.claude/skills/own-skill/SKILL.md
printf '{}' > $R/.claude/evals/cases/own.json
cd $R && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/remove-copy.py | sed -E 's/ +— .*//' | tr -s ' ' | LC_ALL=C sort | tr '\n' ';'

cases.name: --apply deletes the kit's files and the folders left empty, never the repo's
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/rc-{{SID}}
rm -rf $R
mkdir -p $R/.claude/hooks $R/.claude/scripts $R/.claude/skills/implement-tdd/references $R/.claude/skills/own-skill $R/.claude/evals/cases
cp {{KIT}}/hooks/bash-dispatch.sh $R/.claude/hooks/
cp {{KIT}}/scripts/pre-audit.sh $R/.claude/scripts/
printf x > $R/.claude/scripts/own.sh
printf 'read references/extra.md\n' > $R/.claude/skills/implement-tdd/SKILL.md
printf x > $R/.claude/skills/implement-tdd/references/extra.md
printf x > $R/.claude/skills/own-skill/SKILL.md
printf '{}' > $R/.claude/evals/cases/own.json
cd $R && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/remove-copy.py --apply >/dev/null; cd $R/.claude && find . -type f | sort | tr '\n' ';'; [ -d hooks ] && echo hooks-left || echo hooks-gone

cases.name: the mods' former marketplace goes whole, untracked files included
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/rc2-{{SID}}
rm -rf $R
mkdir -p $R/.claude/mods/.claude-plugin $R/.claude/mods/x/node_modules
printf '{}' > $R/.claude/mods/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json
printf x > $R/.claude/mods/x/node_modules/a.js
cd $R && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/remove-copy.py --apply | tail -1; [ -e $R/.claude/mods ] && echo mods-left || echo mods-gone
